versions.subject: Create win_net_use_admin_share.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\net.exe'
        - '\net1.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' use '
        - '\\\\*\*$*'
condition: selection
